#include<stack>

#define N 20
int n,ans=0x3f3f3f3f;
long long mul[N];

int dfs(int now,long long num,int weight,int cnt)
{
    long long mod;stack<int> stack;stack.push(now);bool retire=false;
    if(!num)return cnt;
    while(!stack.empty()){
        if(!retire){mod=num;num=0;retire=true;}
        if(!stack.empty()){
            int i,totle;
            totle=stack.top();retire=false;stack.pop();
            for(i=-10;i*mul[totle]<=mod;i--){if(num>=i*mul[totle])num-=i*mul[totle];else break;}
            if(abs(i)<10)dfs(totle-1,num-i*mul[totle],weight+abs(i)*(totle+1),cnt);
        }
    }
    return min(cnt,ans);
}

int main()
{
    int i;long long num;
    scanf("%lld",&num);
    for(i=1;i<N;i++)mul[i]=mul[i-1]*10L;for(i=1;i<N;i++)mul[i]+=mul[i-1];
    for(i=1;mul[i]<=num;i++);
    n=i;
    ans=dfs(n,num,0,0);
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}
